title: 第23章 阴狠的刘枢草原五雄第24章 名帅之后倒霉的草原五雄
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
杨乾一脸震惊的说道：“我去~赢天你是不是身体发育不正常？”
“这种男人梦寐以求的至宝，你竟然说，不就一点？”
“你这脑袋里，整天装的都是啥？”
赢天闻言满脸黑线道：“你才发育不正常！”
“不就隐身吗？除了用来偷鸡摸狗，下毒暗杀还能用来干啥？”
杨乾闻言啧啧称奇道：“啧啧~赢天我真不知道，到底该说你单纯呢…还是说你生活乏味呢~”
子湮不屑的说道：“呵~也就你们这些对自己不自信的人，才会用这种东西~”
“若是想看，那便光明正大的看~”
“之后负起责任就是了，何须遮遮掩掩？”
李智一脸惊为天人的感慨道：“靠！这是何等虎狼之词？”
“不得不说子湮，还得是你呀~咱们几个中还是属你最猛！”
“狂拽炫酷，屌炸天了都~”
说完连连竖起大拇指。
杨乾同样竖起大拇指道：“佩服佩服~我杨乾愿尊你为，泡妞儿界最强！”
“雅号，硬泡！”
子湮满脸黑线道：“滚一边玩儿去~”
赢天憋笑道：“咳咳~我说哥几个，这才多大年纪就去想那些事儿？”
“再说你们长得都是，风流倜傥，玉树临风，陌上如玉的翩翩美少年了。”
“为啥会想不开，想着去偷窥呢？”
杨乾摆了摆手说道：“低调低调~虽然说我长得的确很帅，不过该低调的时候，咱还得低调。”

“但，隐身这能力，可是男人一辈子的梦想和信仰！无关长相美丑与老少。”
“再说现在用不着，不代表以后用不着啊~”
赢天耸肩说道：“随你们吧，到时候东窗事发，别说我认识你们啊~”
……
另一边，服用了隐身丹的刘枢，悄然来到了恶魂谷的山峰上。
刘枢看着眼前的一群人眯眼道：“果然是，拓跋荣，耶律鉴，完颜庆，孛儿只斤·休戈尔，爱新觉罗·符业这几个家伙。”
“竟然还敢带着，自己的家臣一起来，看来这次得下点猛料了。”
“这回不搞死你们一两个手下，我自己都看不起我自己！”
想到这里，刘枢从怀里取出早已准备好的药粉。
但为了加大剂量，刘枢冒着被发现的风险，从寄灵空间中多取出了几包药粉。
随后从怀里再次取出一颗暗红色的丹药。
将丹药捏成粉末后，加入到了那些药粉之中。
原本淡紫色的药粉，在加入暗红色的丹药药粉后，化为了透明色。
搅拌均匀后，刘枢走到顺风口，乘着风势将药粉通通挥洒至空中。
不一会儿，无色无味的药粉，随着微风飘到了拓跋荣等人身上。
不少药粉更是被他们吸入体内。
刘枢见状嘴角一翘，缓缓的离开了山峰。
在退出隐身状态后，回到了赢天几人的身边。
李智两眼放光的问道：“枢哥怎么样？成了没？”
刘枢奸笑道：“嘿嘿~我出手会空手而归？”
content_en:
Yang Qian said with a shocked look on his face: "I'll go~ Yingtian, are you not developing normally?"
"You actually said that this kind of treasure that men dream of is just a little bit?"
"What's going on in your head all day long?"
When Yingtian heard this, his face was filled with black lines and he said, "You are the one with abnormal development!"
"Isn't it just invisible? Besides being used for sneaking around, poisoning and assassination, what else can it be used for?"
Hearing this, Yang Qian clicked his tongue and said in surprise: "Tsk, tsk~ Yingtian, I really don't know, should I say you are simple...or should I say your life is boring~"
Zi Yan said disdainfully: "Ha~ Only those of you who are not confident in yourself would use this kind of thing~"
"If you want to see it, then do it openly~"
"Just take responsibility from now on, why do you need to be secretive?"
Li Zhi looked shocked and sighed: "Damn! What kind of arrogant words is this?"
"I have to say, Ziyan, it has to be you~ You are still the most powerful among us!"
"It's so cool, my dick is so awesome~"
After saying that, he gave a thumbs up.
Yang Qian also gave a thumbs up and said: "I admire you, I admire you~ I, Yang Gan, would like to respect you as the best in the world of picking up girls!"
"Yahao, hard bubble!"
Ziyan's face was full of black lines and he said: "Go away and play~"
Yingtian suppressed a smile and said: "Ahem~ I mean, brothers, how old are you to think about those things?"
"Besides, you all look like handsome young men, who look like jade trees in the wind and look like jade on the street."
"Why can't you think about it and think about peeping?"
Yang Gan waved his hand and said: "Low-key and low-key~ Although I am indeed very handsome, when it is time to be low-key, I still have to be low-key."
"However, the ability to be invisible is a man's lifelong dream and belief! It has nothing to do with appearance, age or age."
"Besides, just because you don't need it now, doesn't mean you won't need it in the future~"
Ying Tian shrugged and said: "It's up to you. When the incident comes out, don't say I know you~"
…
On the other side, Liu Shu, who had taken the Invisibility Pill, quietly arrived at the peak of the Evil Soul Valley.
Liu Shu looked at the group of people in front of him and narrowed his eyes and said, "Sure enough, it's Tuoba Rong, Yelvjian, Wanyanqing, Bo'er Jijin Hugor, Aixinjueluo Fuye and these guys."
"You actually dare to bring your own retainers with you. It seems like you're going to have to do something serious this time."
"If I don't kill one or two of your men this time, I'll even look down on myself!"
Thinking of this, Liu Shu took out the medicinal powder that had been prepared from his arms.
But in order to increase the dose, Liu Shu took out a few more packets of medicinal powder from the spirit space at the risk of being discovered.
Then he took out another dark red pill from his arms.
After kneading the elixir into powder, he added it to the powdered medicine.
The originally light purple medicinal powder turned into a transparent color after adding the dark red elixir powder.
After stirring evenly, Liu Shu walked downwind and took advantage of the wind to scatter the medicinal powder into the air.
After a while, the colorless and odorless medicinal powder floated to Tuobarong and others with the breeze.
A lot of medicinal powder was even inhaled into their bodies.
Upon seeing this, Liu Shu raised the corner of his mouth and slowly left the mountain.
After exiting the invisibility state, he returned to Yingtian and the others.
Li Zhi asked with bright eyes: "How is Brother Shu? Is it done?"
Liu Shu smiled evilly and said: "Hehe~ Will I come back empty-handed if I take action?"
